children: Australia base metals developer's annual operating loss narrowed yr/yr
Basic and headline loss per share both narrowed compared to prior yr
Orion Minerals is focused on advancing project execution at Prieska Copper Zinc Mine and Okiep Copper Project
Company aims to bring Okiep Copper Project to updated development case to define next stage and construction pathway
No specific financial or production guidance provided for the current or upcoming periods in the press release
PROJECT DEVELOPMENT COSTS - Operating loss was primarily driven by contractor and advisor expenses related to advancing project development
EXPLORATION EXPENSES - Exploration expenditure of AUD2.65 million was expensed under the Group’s deferred exploration, evaluation and development policy
FINANCE INCOME OFFSET - Finance income of AUD4.90 million, mainly from interest receivable, partially offset operating loss
Sept 15 - Australia's Santos signs two separate LNG agreements with POSCO Steel and Western LNG
